basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old avid reader and aspiring writer living in Brooklyn, New York. I work as a freelance graphic designer and spend my free time exploring the city, reading new novels, or binging on YouTube videos. I recently joined Reddit to dive into discussions about my favorite books and keep up with the latest trends in writing and publishing. My online hours are usually late at night after my work is done. I'm currently single and enjoy meeting new people through various online communities.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Graphic Design from a local university and have been working in the field for over three years. My self-taught knowledge spans literature, particularly modern fiction, and I am a huge fan of online video content creation.
